title: Webhooks
description: Signed HTTPS callbacks when something happens: a device goes online or offline, a recording session starts, ends or completes, a workflow emits an event. Register an endpoint once, then route to it from a device (`PUT /devices/{id}/webhooks`) or from a workflow's Emit Event node. Deliveries follow Standard Webhooks and are retried for about 44 hours. The payload of each event type is under `x-webhooks`.
